item.title: GPG - All I Need to Know
item.description: While I need to use GPG pretty regularly, I always have to look up the commands - they just don’t stick :-) Over the last couple of months I collected every command I had to use. Enjoy! create a key gpg --quick-generate-key user-id # or gpg --generate-key # or gpg --full-generate-key delete a private key gpg --delete-secret-keys key-id delete a public key gpg --delete-key key-id encrypt a file gpg --encrypt --recipient someone@example.
